[[syntax trees at end of                     typer]] // ConditionalMutableReferenceAssignment.scala
package example {
  class Counter(start: Int) extends Object() {
    private[this] val start: Int
    private[this] var current: Int = Counter.this.start
    def get(): Int = this.current
    def set(value: Int): Unit = this.current = value
  }
  class Pair(first: example.Counter, second: example.Counter) extends Object() {
    private[this] val first: example.Counter
    private[this] val second: example.Counter
    private[this] val left: example.Counter = Pair.this.first
    private[this] val right: example.Counter = Pair.this.second
    def leftValue(): Int = this.left.get()
    def rightValue(): Int = this.right.get()
  }
  class PairFactory() extends Object() {
    def create(firstSeed: Int, secondSeed: Int, chooseSecond: Boolean,
      nextValue: Int): example.Pair =
      {
        val first: example.Counter = new example.Counter(firstSeed)
        val second: example.Counter = new example.Counter(secondSeed)
        var selected: example.Counter = first
        if chooseSecond then selected = second else selected = first
        selected.set(nextValue)
        new example.Pair(first, second)
      }
  }
}
